Package aor.proj3t.entities

Class Notification

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.entities.Notification
@Entity public class Notification extends Object
Entity representing a notification sent to users in the system. Notifications are system-generated messages that inform users about various events, activities, or status changes within the application.
